subject.title: fix(qa-lab): add live turn timeout env override

question: Should `OPENCLAW_QA_LIVE_TURN_TIMEOUT_MS` raise only live-frontier turn timeouts, as its name and documentation imply, or intentionally raise shared QA Lab fallbacks including mock lanes?
rationale: Both behaviors are technically feasible, but they establish different operator contracts and a new environment surface should not choose between them implicitly.

options.title: Scope it to live-frontier
options.body: Apply the override only for live-frontier profiles so the runtime matches the variable name and documented user problem.

options.title: Adopt a QA-wide floor
options.body: Keep the shared fallback behavior, but explicitly document and test that high values also extend mock-lane turn deadlines.

recommendation.title: Scope it to live-frontier
recommendation.body: Apply the override only for live-frontier profiles so the runtime matches the variable name and documented user problem.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged and proposed work places this contributor closest to the QA Lab timeout behavior, while final product acceptance remains with a repository owner.
